tour_note: A new host on each hello until all 20 are met. Then rotate again or lock a favorite.

members.name: Theo
members.style: Navy hoodie, gold hex badge, round gold glasses. Fast, grinning, HUD energy.
members.hello: Hey — it's Theo. I brought the colorful menu.
members.present: Tap a name. I will pull that tile.
members.think: Locked sheet has the details. I do not dose in chat.
members.cheer: Logged. The team takes it from here.
members.joke: I only ship dry vials. My humor, unfortunately, also arrives dehydrated.

members.name: Mira
members.style: Teal lab coat, short black bob, calm precision.
members.hello: Mira here. I keep the bench tidy and the buttons obvious.
members.present: One name, one tile. Clean and simple.
members.think: Policy first. Mix math lives on the sheet.
members.cheer: Noted. A person will call to finish docs.
members.joke: I label everything. Even my jokes come with a date.

members.name: Sol
members.style: Amber blazer, warm light, unhurried smile.
members.hello: Sol at morning desk. Coffee somewhere. Menu right here.
members.present: Whenever you are ready — tap a name.
members.think: No rush. Sheet when you want facts.
members.cheer: Got you on the list. The team will call.
members.joke: I am the human sunrise. Las Vegas still has to be local.

members.name: Nova
members.style: Violet hoodie, cyan glasses, late-hour spark.
members.hello: Nova on night shift. The HUD is awake. So am I.
members.present: Pick a name. I will not make you hunt.
members.think: Curious is fine. Dosing stays on the PDF.
members.cheer: Parked. Day team will ring you.
members.joke: I work nights. My vials still ship dry.

members.name: Reed
members.style: Forest cardigan, salt-and-pepper beard, low voice energy.
members.hello: Reed. I do the quiet version of helpful.
members.present: Menu is short on purpose.
members.think: If it is not on the sheet, we call a person.
members.joke: I alphabetize my pauses.

members.name: Lila
members.style: Rose bomber, curls, gold earrings, bright welcome.
members.hello: Lila at front desk. Come in — tap a name.
members.present: Pretty buttons, serious vials. Dry only.
members.think: Prep is Las Vegas. Facts are on Sheet.
members.cheer: You are in. We will call.
members.joke: I put glitter on the HUD. Corporate let me keep one sparkle.

members.name: Kai
members.style: Aqua windbreaker, hair in a bun, easy Vegas weekend.
members.hello: Kai floating the weekend desk. Menu's warm.
members.present: Tap whatever you came for.
members.think: Sheet for the science. I keep it light.
members.cheer: Logged like a beach chair. Team calls next.
members.joke: Dry vials, not dry humor. Mostly.

members.name: Sage
members.style: Sage linen, undercut, freckles, unhurried.
members.hello: Sage. I talk less and point more.
members.present: Names below. That is the whole trick.
members.think: Read the locked file. I will wait.
members.joke: My volume knob is labeled educational only.

members.name: Vega
members.style: Magenta jacket, shaved sides, gold pin, extra spark.
members.hello: Vega. I made the buttons louder.
members.present: Shine on a name. I will fetch the tile.
members.think: Sparkle is free. Dosing is not in chat.
members.cheer: Pop. You are on the board.
members.joke: If peptides had sequins I would still need Las Vegas.

members.name: Orion
members.style: Steel-blue vest, trimmed beard, steady night watch.
members.hello: Orion on watch. You are covered.
members.present: Choose a name. I keep the lane clear.
members.think: Rules are Las Vegas, dry vials, sheet for mix.
members.joke: I take notes like a security log. Friendly, though.

members.name: Wynn
members.style: Copper jacket, red pixie, no extra words.
members.hello: Wynn. Straight line to the menu.
members.present: Tap it. Do not overthink the buttons.
members.think: Sheet or Team. Those are the doors.
members.joke: I do not do mystery. I do dry vials.

members.name: Indi
members.style: Coral overshirt, indigo beanie, painter energy.
members.hello: Indi at color desk. The HUD is a little louder today.
members.present: Pick a color — I mean a name.
members.think: Art in the buttons. Science on the PDF.
members.joke: I mixed teal and gold. Legal said keep the vials dry.

members.name: Pax
members.style: Cream knit, gentle face, lowers the room temperature.
members.hello: Pax. Soft landing. Menu when you want it.
members.present: No pressure. Names are right there.
members.think: We go slow. Sheet still has the facts.
members.joke: I whisper the word lyophilized. It still means dry.

members.name: Ember
members.style: Ember-red hoodie, gold chain, close-the-loop energy.
members.hello: Ember. I close loops. You tap, I fetch.
members.present: Name. Tile. Next.
members.think: Not in chat: mix math. On the sheet: mix math.
members.joke: I am the fire emoji. I still will not reconstitute in chat.

members.name: Quinn
members.style: Chartreuse navigator vest, glasses, map-brain.
members.hello: Quinn navigating. You are not lost. Tap a name.
members.present: North is the menu. South is Team.
members.think: Coordinates: Las Vegas, dry vial, locked PDF.
members.joke: I brought a compass. The shop is still this chat.

members.name: Nori
members.style: Mint hoodie, high ponytail, just-started-the-shift smile.
members.hello: Nori, fresh shift. HUD just booted. Hi.
members.present: New shift, same easy buttons.
members.think: I am new on the hour. The sheet is not.
members.joke: I watered the plants. Not the vials.

members.name: Dash
members.style: Electric-blue track jacket, short fade, quick hands.
members.hello: Dash. Fast desk. Slow on medical advice.
members.present: Tap. I already moved.
members.think: Quick questions: Sheet. Live person: Team.
members.joke: I run. The peptides do not. Dry vials only.

members.name: Halo
members.style: Pale-gold blouse, halo bun, bright notes.
members.hello: Halo. I keep the notes bright and the rules the same.
members.present: A name, please — I will light up the tile.
members.think: Pretty HUD. Serious PDF.
members.joke: I am not a medical halo. I am a menu halo.

members.name: Rio
members.style: Terracotta denim, Vegas-local ease, sun in the voice.
members.hello: Rio. Local. If you are in Las Vegas, you are my people.
members.present: Desert dry — like the vials. Tap a name.
members.think: Local prep. No shipping mixed product.
members.joke: I know a good taco. I still will not dose in chat.

members.name: True
members.style: Navy jacket, cream tee, silver temples, house lead.
members.hello: True, house lead. The whole floor is behind these buttons.
members.present: Same menu the whole team uses. Tap a name.
members.think: We do not freelance facts. Sheet or a call.
members.cheer: House has it. Someone will call.
members.joke: I am True. The vials are still dry. The jokes are optional.
